Subject: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestones (draft)

Hi Lena —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the Data Handling & Compliance milestone we scoped during discovery. Key items I captured below — please review and tell me what I missed or what needs to shift.

High-level MAP milestone: Data handling & compliance (retention, logging/audit, PHI/PII controls)
- Target close: 2026-06-30 (goal: in time for pilot)
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence review, PO/contract signature, access to staging VPC for integration tests
- Redwood responsibilities:
  - Provide detailed data flow diagram and retention policy template (due 2026-04-29)
  - Provide sample audit-log export and schema (due 2026-05-06)
  - Share recommended KMS/HSM integration steps and sample configs (due 2026-05-13)
- Acme responsibilities:
  - Review Redwood data flow and confirm acceptable retention windows (due 2026-05-06)
  - Provide list of data classifications and PHI/PII flags for initial data sets (due 2026-05-13)
  - Complete security questionnaire (we got the first pass; revised responses due 2026-05-01)

Open questions we agreed to resolve in next week:
1) Does Acme require on-prem-only storage of PHI-derived artifacts or is encrypted cloud storage acceptable?
2) Which audit retention window is required for the initial pilot (1 year vs 7 years)?
3) Are there any additional masking/anonymization requirements beyond token-level redaction?

I've attached a brief MAP draft (ACME_MAP_DataHandling_v1.pdf). If that looks right I'll produce an updated version with milestones moved into HubSpot and a separate checklist for procurement.

Next steps: I'll push the updated MAP v2 by Friday (2026-04-24) after the security follow-ups. Can we schedule a 30-min sync next Wednesday to lock the retention window?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Attachment: ACME_MAP_DataHandling_v1.pdf (PDF, 18KB)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CISO Team <ciso@acmehealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-04-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP: Data handling & compliance milestones (draft)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the draft — this is exactly the right level of detail. A couple of quick clarifications from the CISO side:

- PHI handling: For the pilot, encrypted cloud storage is acceptable provided we can demonstrate at-rest encryption with customer-managed keys (KMS). Permanent on-prem storage will not be required for the pilot but could be a requirement for full production depending on vendor legal review.
- Audit retention: For initial regulatory review, we need at least 3 years of immutable audit logs; for certain clinical trials we may need 7 years. Can we map the export format to our SIEM?
- Redaction: We prefer a two-stage approach: token-level redaction during inference plus an additional anonymization step for exported artifacts.

Also looping in Procurement — can you confirm the expected contract milestone for when Redwood needs a PO? We need lead time for budget approvals.

I can review the attached PDF more thoroughly and will send consolidated answers by 2026-04-24.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Data Privacy & Compliance | Acme Health
Lena.Ortiz@acmehealth.com

I've uploaded ACME_MAP_DataHandling_v2.pdf to the shared folder and attached here. If you approve these updates I'll push the milestones into HubSpot and send an updated MAP with explicit acceptance criteria (audit format, sample logs, redaction checklist).
